title: Cooper Davis and Devin Norring Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary:
Cooper Davis and Devin Norring Act

This bill requires electronic communication service providers and remote computing service providers to report knowledge of offenses involving the creation, manufacture, distribution, or dispensing of counterfeit controlled substances (including counterfeit prescription drugs), fentanyl, methamphetamine, or prescription pain medications or stimulants to the Drug Enforcement Administration. Providers are subject to criminal and civil penalties for failing to comply with these requirements.
